## Real instance

Describe where this happened and what a person experienced. Remove confidential names and data.

## Evidence

## Why the current taxonomy cannot name it

List the closest existing defect ids and explain why each one is not the same condition.

## Proposed presence test

Complete this sentence: `Present when...`

## Standards hook

## Fix pattern

Describe the smallest reliable way to remove the condition.
